cues.cap: Welcome to WCAG Learn.
cues.say: Welcome to W-CAG Learn.

cues.cap: This is success criterion 1.1.1: Non-text Content.
cues.say: This is success criterion one point one point one: Non-text Content.

cues.cap: It's Level A — the foundation every site needs.
cues.say: It's Level A — the foundation every site needs.

cues.cap: The rule: everything that isn't text — images, icons, charts, picture buttons —
cues.say: The rule: everything that isn't text — images, icons, charts, picture buttons —

cues.cap: needs a text alternative that does the same job.
cues.say: needs a text alternative that does the same job.

cues.cap: Meet Sam — shopping at Sneaker Street with a screen reader.
cues.say: Meet Sam — shopping at Sneaker Street with a screen reader.

cues.cap: Sam lands on a photo of a red high-top sneaker.
cues.say: Sam lands on a photo of a red high-top sneaker.

cues.cap: On the accessible page, the screen reader says:
cues.say: On the accessible page, the screen reader says:

cues.cap: “Red canvas high-top sneaker with white rubber sole. Image.”
cues.say: Red canvas high-top sneaker, with white rubber sole. Image.

cues.cap: Sam knows exactly what's for sale.
cues.say: Sam knows exactly what's for sale.

cues.cap: But the Buy-now button is a picture, and its alt text is “button1”.
cues.say: But the buy now button is a picture, and its alt text is button one.

cues.cap: The screen reader just says: “button one.”
cues.say: The screen reader just says: button one.

cues.cap: Sam has no idea what pressing it will do.
cues.say: Sam has no idea what pressing it will do.

cues.cap: Time to test. Way one: turn on a screen reader, like VoiceOver.
cues.say: Time to test. Way one: turn on a screen reader, like VoiceOver.

cues.cap: Move through the page. Does every image announce something useful?
cues.say: Move through the page. Does every image announce something useful?

cues.cap: Way two: inspect the image and check its alt attribute.
cues.say: Way two: inspect the image, and check its alt attribute.

cues.cap: Missing? A file name? A label like “button1”?
cues.say: Missing? A file name? A label like button one?

cues.cap: That's a fail.
cues.say: That's a fail.

cues.cap: The fix is one attribute. Say what the image is for:
cues.say: The fix is one attribute. Say what the image is for:

cues.cap: alt="Buy now"
cues.say: alt equals, Buy now.

cues.cap: Pure decoration? Use an empty alt, so screen readers skip it.
cues.say: Pure decoration? Use an empty alt, so screen readers skip it.

cues.cap: Then retest with your screen reader.
cues.say: Then retest with your screen reader.

cues.cap: When you hear “Buy now, button” — that's a pass.
cues.say: When you hear, Buy now, button — that's a pass.

cues.cap: That's 1.1.1: if it's not text, give it text.
cues.say: That's one point one point one: if it's not text, give it text.

cues.cap: One down, fifty-five to go.
cues.say: One down, fifty-five to go.

cues.cap: Study all 56, free, at wcaglearn.com.
cues.say: Study all fifty-six, free, at W-CAG-learn dot com.
